evidence: Ingested data/training_data.csv into Hopsworks feature group leakage_fg (v1, 800 rows, 269 positives) and analyzed it on-platform with Trino SQL over the offline (Delta) store. Pearson corr(feature, label): f1=0.106, f2=0.116, f3=0.101, f4=0.992, f5=0.179, f6=0.077. f4's correlation (0.992) dwarfs every other feature. Per-class stats confirm leakage: for label=0, f4 in [-0.385, 0.417] (mean -0.001); for label=1, f4 in [2.121, 3.000] (mean 2.497). The two ranges do not overlap, so a single threshold (e.g. f4 > 1.0) classifies every row perfectly — characteristic of a feature computed from post-outcome data.
